summary: Search for missing 11-year-old Gannon Stauch expanded to a ~35-acre rough-terrain area west of Larkspur in southern Douglas County; investigators plus 80+ volunteers and canines searched Feb 12-13; EPCSO-led search suspended Feb 21 without locating him
responding_agency: El Paso County Sheriff's Office (lead); Douglas County SAR and other search-and-rescue teams
notes: Reported missing Jan 27, 2020 from Colorado Springs area; Douglas County search ran Feb 12-21, 2020 then suspended; search subject never located during this effort; date approximate to search start (Feb-12 pin from AP suspension-story text; parent-opened Oxygen article confirms the Douglas County search facts)
